name: Medium user RSS feed
tier_rationale: A Medium Corporation, an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P116 FC9.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

user_rss.title: Medium user RSS (medium.com/feed/@{username})

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

user_rss.notes: Research C0270 + live check 2026-11-26: 404 = ABSENT (the ordinary 404 page embeds Cloudflare's passive precursor script: not a challenge); profile pages may be served a Cloudflare managed challenge (BLOCKED, never retried). The feed carries the last ~10 posts; post titles and outbound domains are content (only when relevant to the case, P116 FC8).
